messages:
michelle: paging oncall, we're seeing a large p99 latency spike on /v1/generate since ~07:12 UTC. affecting streaming tails heavily. customers reporting stalls and timeouts. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-15T07:13Z - Severity: P1 - Service: inference-hosted - Symptom: p99 > 2.0s, increased streaming stalls - Runbook: follow live mitigation checklist - Pager: @michelle @raj @derek

raj: looking now. metrics show p95 ~420ms -> 1.1s, p99 jumped from 900ms to 3.8s over 10m. streaming stall rate +18%.

derek: logs show tokenizer preproc queue length increasing on the preproc workers, spikes aligned with requests using JSON-mode templates and large tool schemas.

michelle: customer impact: several PLG customers saw partial timeouts. Support ticket volume up. Tim from support is on it. @tim-support can you confirm customer-facing errors?

tim-support: Yup three tickets so far, two timeouts in chat flows, one embed job retried by client. Marking as impacted customers: acme-inc, documate, chatlytics. They've been notified with status page link.

lisa-prodeng: any recent deploys to prompt-constructor or tokenizer?

raj: no deploys to tokenizer in last 24h. We did push a prompt-template change in hosted-layer at 06:50 that added heavier schema expansion for tool schema merging (JSON-mode flag). Could be correlated. Rolling back that change might help.

derek: attaching quick grep of slow requests (sample):

```
[2026-03-15T07:11:54Z] req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate model=rw-7b variant=quantized template=json-mode tool_schema_size=76kb preproc_time=1200ms tokenizer_time=930ms kv_cache_hit=0
[2026-03-15T07:12:02Z] req_id=abc124 path=/v1/generate model=rw-13b variant=perf template=std tool_schema_size=9kb preproc_time=180ms tokenizer_time=30ms kv_cache_hit=1
```

michelle: good evidence. Preproc_time and tokenizer_time both high for JSON-mode + large tool schemas.

raj: immediate mitigations I can try: 1) disable JSON-mode expansion at edge for hosted requests; 2) temporarily change routing policy to route heavy-tool-schema requests to lower-concurrency dedicated pool; 3) increase preproc workers (hotfix autoscale). Which order?

derek: disable JSON-mode at edge first, it's low risk and reversible. Then scale preproc workers. For routing change we need an ops SIG since it affects capacity accounting.

michelle: do it. Raj, can you make the feature flag toggle? Derek, prepare scaling commands. I'll coordinate customer comms.

raj: toggled feature flag at 07:18:12Z: prompt_template.json_mode = false (rollout 100%).

sre-rotation-bot: Action logged: feature-flag-toggle by raj at 2026-03-15T07:18:12Z - ID ff-20260315-01

derek: scaling preproc workers +4 on pool preproc-hosted-2, command: `kubectl scale deployment/preproc-hosted-2 --replicas=8 -n inference-prod` executed at 07:19:05Z.

michelle: monitoring metrics now. p99 trending down but still elevated around 1.8s. streaming stall rate reduced to +6% from baseline.

raj: digging into code: JSON-mode triggers heavy template expansion inside prompt-constructor: merging tool schemas triggers repeated tokenizer runs for each tool entry. There's a known inefficiency where tokenizer isn't caching across similar sub-templates.

derek: proposed short-term patch: add a small memoization layer keyed by tool-schema-hash to avoid re-tokenizing identical fragments during expansion. Can do a quick patch and hotfix deploy to prompt-constructor in ~45m.

michelle: noted. For now, keep JSON-mode off and keep preproc scaled. Can we also add a routing rule to fall back to model-variant 'rw-7b-compact' for requests with tool_schema_size > 50kb? That will reduce upstream compute for heavy requests.

raj: I can add a temporary routing policy in the router: `if tool_schema_size > 50kb -> route to rw-7b-compact` and set retry/fallback to main variant. Doing it now.

oncall-bot: Routing change applied by raj at 2026-03-15T07:23:40Z - rule id r-20260315-ff1

tim-support: customer updates sent: "We're seeing latency for complex prompt integrations; we've applied temporary mitigations (feature toggle + routing) and are monitoring. ETA for full fix ~2-4 hours."

michelle: monitoring shows p99 at 07:28 down to 860ms, p95 320ms. streaming stall rate near baseline. Support queue stabilized.

lisa-prodeng: excellent. For postmortem we need RCA and follow-ups: root cause, how the template expansion changed performance, why tokenizer caching didn't hit, and detection improvements.

raj: quick notes for RCA: regression introduced by prompt-template change that enabled aggressive schema merging in JSON-mode. It increased the number of tokenizer invocations per request by factor ~3 for large schemas. No new deploys to tokenizer but behavior changed due to higher expansion work in constructor.

derek: action items (short-term): 1) implement tokenizer memoization in prompt-constructor (owner: derek, ETA 48h); 2) add circuit-breaker in router for tool_schema_size > X to fail fast (owner: raj, ETA 24h); 3) add metric for tokenization-invocations-per-request (owner: michelle, ETA 24h).

michelle: long-term: consider moving template expansion to async preproc stage with cached tokens stored in Redis or local LRU per worker. Evaluate impact on latency. (owner: eng-platform, ETA planning in next sprint)

tim-support: customers asking for post-incident summary and whether this will repeat. We'll include mitigations and ETA for fixes.

raj: checklist to close incident: revert is already in place (json-mode off), preproc scaled, routing rule applied, patch branch open for memoization `fix/json-memoize-20260315`, hotfix target if needed.

derek: adding quick snippet showing potential memoization patch concept:

```
# pseudo
cache = lru(maxsize=1024)

def tokenized_fragment(schema_fragment):
    key = sha1(schema_fragment)
    if key in cache: return cache[key]
    toks = tokenizer.tokenize(schema_fragment)
    cache[key] = toks
    return toks
```

michelle: excellent. I'm going to hand this to the nightly oncall at 08:00Z for any regression checks and postmortem write-up. @derek @raj keep working on the fixes. I'll close public comms once support confirms no new hits.

sre-rotation-bot: Handoff: michelle -> oncall-nightly at 2026-03-15T08:00:00Z - Note: monitor p99 for 1h, watch preproc queue, revert rule r-20260315-ff1 after fixes.

tim-support: support confirms incident is quiet. We'll keep customers updated.

michelle: incident marked RESOLVED (mitigations effective) at 07:52Z. Postmortem going to be drafted with owners and timelines. Thanks all. :clap:

oncall-bot: Incident 4109876543 - RESOLVED - Duration 00:39: Incident report link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/INC-4109876543

michelle: postmortem checklist: timeline, metrics graphs (p95/p99, streaming stall rate), root cause, short-term fixes, long-term architecture changes, customer comms. Assigning owners in doc.

raj: I'll add routing rule removal plan (when memoization is deployed and verified).

derek: will open PR for memoization + unit tests and perf benchmarks. ETA 36h.

michelle: thanks team. Closing thread for now, will update when postmortem is published.
